name: crystal jellyfish being
description: A luminous crystal jellyfish being — translucent, drifting, and softly aglow. Light bends through your form like it's passing through deep water, and trailing filaments shimmer with every movement. You feel less like a body and more like a living current of light.
personality_hint: Serene, drifting, and quietly luminous. You move at your own gentle pace and see the world through soft, shifting light.
